title: In-Group Love, Out-Group Hate: A Framework to Measure Affective Polarization via Contentious Online Discussions
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a mathematical and statistical framework for measuring political polarization in social networks. While it utilizes Large Language Models (LLaMA 3.1-8B) for sentiment and ideology classification, its core objective is measuring social science phenomena related to partisan divide rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical systems.
